ch7_general: 1) Exalted / own / friendly rāśi → very good / good / ordinary; inimical or debilitated → no good result.
2) Transiting graha benefic to the rāśi → good; malefic to the rāśi → intensified evil.
3) Benefic aspects or friendly association intensify good, minimise bad.
4) Malefic aspects or enemy association intensify bad, minimise good.
7) Benefic in own daśā intensifies positive (needs natal/company chart – not applied).
8) Malefic in own daśā intensifies negative (not applied).
9) Eclipse in favourable rāśi → incapable of favourable results.
10) Eclipse in unfavourable rāśi → intensifies evil.
11) Hemmed between 2 malefics in favourable rāśi → positive reduced.
12) Hemmed between 2 malefics in unfavourable rāśi → negative intensified.
13) Hemmed between 2 benefics in favourable rāśi → positive at peak.
14) Hemmed between 2 benefics in unfavourable rāśi → negative reduced.
17) 4+ grahas in one rāśi → neutral, directionless & volatile.

ch9.text: Conjunction, semi-sextile 30°, semi-square 45°, sextile 60°, square 90°, trine 120°, sesquiquadrate 135°, opposition 180°. Most powerful: conjunction & opposition; next: square, trine, sextile; others weak.
ch9.engine: Calibrated (see Validation): sign-based Vedic graha-dṛṣṭi (all grahas 7th; Maṅgala 4/8; Guru 5/9; Śani 3/10; Rāhu/Ketu 5/9) + conjunction (same rāśi) + trine (5th/9th rāśi) for every graha. Strength scaled by type and degree exactness. Slow-planet cycle aspects (Ch.16 Guru→Śani) use degree aspects with 3° orb (calibrated on 10-Jan-2008, 01-Feb-2008, 21-Aug-2008, 11-Dec-2008).

ch12.text: Micro-viṃśottarī from Candra longitude in the opening-bell chart; balance of first daśā = period × unelapsed fraction of nakṣatra. Worked example: 12-Mar-2009 09:55 Mumbai, Candra Kanyā 11°32′ → Candra balance 35 min 24 s (09:55:00–10:30:24), then Ma 28, Ra 72, Gu 64, Sa 76, Bu 68, Ke 28.

rules: Guru exalted/own/friendly rāśi or favourably aspected → gold strong; enemy/debilitated or malefic aspects → gold weak
Guru udita (rising) → gold demand rises; Guru asta (combust) → gold demand falls
Guru aspected by Sūrya or Candra → favourable for gold
Guru conjunct Rāhu/Ketu (within ~30°) → hyperinflationary surge in gold
Guru retrograde and separating from Rāhu → gold falls (2008 example)
Śani conjunct Rāhu or Ketu → crude soars; separation from conjunction → crude plunges from peak
Candra, Śani, Uranus, Neptune, Rāhu, Ketu benefically placed / aspected by benefics → crude up
Node moving into a watery rāśi "cools" crude; Śani in fiery rāśi keeps it "bubbling hot"

ch19.text: Dīpāvali Muhurat session closing positive → bullish Samvat year; negative → bearish year.

ch20.text: Partial inverse correlation: when equities collapse from peak, gold rises; when equities recover, gold slips.
